# Scenario: China Stimulus / Reopening Boost

## Trigger
- PBOC cuts MLF/LPR rates aggressively
- Fiscal stimulus announced (infrastructure, consumption vouchers)
- Credit impulse turns sharply positive (> +3%)
- Property sector stabilization measures take hold

## Macro Assumptions

| Variable | Baseline | 6-Month | 12-Month |
|----------|---------|---------|----------|
| PBOC MLF Rate | X.XX% | -20bp | -40bp |
| China Credit Impulse | +X.X | +2.0 | +4.0 |
| CNY/USD | X.XX | -3% | -5% |
| Copper (USD/tonne) | $X,XXX | +15% | +25% |
| Iron Ore (USD/tonne) | $XX | +20% | +30% |
| China GDP Growth | X.X% | +1pp | +2pp |
| Global PMI | XX.X | +1pt | +2pt |

## Transmission Channels

### Commodity Channel (Primary)
- Copper, iron ore: +20-30% (China = 50%+ of global demand)
- LNG: +15-25% (energy transition demand)
- Agricultural: +10-20% (soybeans, corn for livestock rebuild)
- Oil: +10-15% (transportation, industrial demand)

### FX Channel
- AUD, NZD, CAD: +5-10% (commodity currency rally)
- CNY: Managed appreciation
- EM FX broadly: +3-8% (capital inflows)
- USD (DXY): -3-5% (global growth reduces safe haven demand)

### Equity Channel
- Australia (ASX): +10-15% (mining, banks)
- New Zealand (NZX): +5-10% (dairy, tourism)
- Brazil (IBOV): +10-15% (iron ore, agri)
- Chile (IPSA): +10-20% (copper)
- EM broadly: +8-15%
- China (CSI 300): +15-25% (direct stimulus beneficiary)

### Rate Channel
- Global bond yields rise modestly (growth optimism)
- Commodity currencies price fewer cuts
- RBA, RBNZ hold rates higher for longer

## Sector Impact Matrix

| Sector | Impact | Driver |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Mining | 🟢 +15 to +30% | Commodity prices |
| Energy | 🟢 +10 to +20% | LNG, coal, oil demand |
| Industrials | 🟢 +10 to +15% | Global capex cycle |
| Shipping | 🟢 +15 to +25% | Trade volume surge |
| Luxury Goods | 🟢 +10 to +20% | Chinese consumer demand |
| Tourism (AU/NZ/TH) | 🟢 +10 to +15% | Chinese outbound travel |
| Tech (global) | 🟡 0 to +10% | Indirect via EM demand |

## Key Beneficiary Countries
1. Australia (iron ore, LNG, education, tourism)
2. Brazil (iron ore, soybeans)
3. Chile / Peru (copper)
4. New Zealand (dairy, tourism)
5. Indonesia / Malaysia (commodities, manufacturing)
6. South Africa (platinum, coal, iron ore)

## Key Monitoring Triggers
- [ ] PBOC MLF rate cut > 10bp
- [ ] Aggregate financing growth > 10% YoY
- [ ] Property sales stabilize (monthly data)
- [ ] Copper price breaks above recent range
- [ ] AUD/USD breaks above 200-day moving average
